projects.title: EcoXchange – AI-Driven Smart Recycling Management System
projects.description: An AI-powered recycling management platform designed to streamline recycling collection processes by connecting customers, recycling centres, staff, and riders. Features AI-assisted recyclable item classification, geolocation-based services, and intelligent pickup suggestions to improve collection efficiency and user experience.

projects.title: Project Guardian – AI-Powered Maritime Vessel Detection & Situational Awareness System
projects.description: An AI-powered maritime monitoring system developed to enhance vessel detection, identification, tracking, and situational awareness. Integrates YOLO11 object detection and binary classification with a fail-closed decision architecture, CPA/TCPA calculations, and a geographic dashboard for maritime monitoring.

projects.title: SkillVora
projects.description: A web-based career path exploration system designed to help users discover suitable career options based on their interests and skills. Focuses on clear information flow, user-friendly navigation, and responsive design.

projects.title: Smart Toilet IoT Monitoring System
projects.description: Designed and developed a smart toilet management system using IoT technology to automate restroom monitoring and maintenance. The system integrates ESP32 microcontrollers and multiple sensors to track occupancy, water tank levels, air quality, and cleanliness indicators. Real-time data is transmitted to a cloud database and visualized through a responsive web dashboard, allowing maintenance staff to receive alerts, optimize cleaning schedules, and improve facility efficiency.
